recruitment-delivery.description: Mapping recruitment workflows and designing AI collaboration around shared project context to reduce repeated explanations of hiring criteria and disconnected analysis.
recruitment-delivery.title: Executive Search: Keeping Hiring Criteria Consistent Throughout Delivery

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Keep requirements, candidate decisions and client feedback useful throughout recruiting delivery

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Map recruiting workflows, AI capabilities and human review boundaries

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Business workflows, nine task capabilities and a shared project dossier design

steps.title: Submit candidate materials
steps.text: A delivery consultant submits materials to start analysis under agreed rules. This is a design for proactive collaboration within a recruiting project.

steps.title: Read the project dossier and analyze
steps.text: Compare new resumes with search criteria and previous decisions; ask the consultant to supply missing critical information.

steps.title: Draft a recommendation
steps.text: Use shared evaluation methods to identify fit, risks and supporting evidence, then submit the draft to the project lead for review and confirmation.

steps.title: Record feedback and follow up
steps.text: Retain review outcomes and reasons for changes, linking client feedback to the candidate and role. The lead decides whether the search direction should change.

creator-marketing-delivery.description: Designing a creator delivery workflow with shared criteria across client confirmation, operational sourcing and agent-assisted review.
creator-marketing-delivery.title: Creator Marketing: Shared Criteria for Sourcing, Review and Shortlist Delivery

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Use the same confirmed criteria for sourcing, review and shortlist delivery

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Requirements analysis, screening design and collaborative workflow design

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Creator sourcing briefs, candidate review and shortlist feedback workflows

steps.title: Clarify and confirm requirements
steps.text: The project manager communicates with the client in a group chat while AI organizes the requirements. Manager review and client confirmation produce a creator sourcing brief.

steps.title: Operational sourcing and submission
steps.text: The brief goes to the project's delivery operators, who source creators against shared criteria and submit their information to the agent.

steps.title: Agent review and feedback
steps.text: Review against confirmed client requirements: update the shortlist and add recommendation reasons when criteria are met; otherwise return specific reasons to the operator.

steps.title: Connect delivery through project context
steps.text: Retain ownership, operational responsibilities, confirmed requirements and review status. Confirm requirement changes before updating the active sourcing guide.

intent.description: Building a workspace that connects records, projects, tasks and actions to address repeated organization in personal AI collaboration.
intent.title: Intent: Connecting Ideas in Conversations to Action

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Turn records, decisions and execution results into reusable working context

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Independent product design, development and personal assistant integration

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Web workspace, business services, MCP interfaces and organization reports

steps.title: Capture a record
steps.text: Retain the original input and source, then let AI organize it and associate it with existing projects.

steps.title: Review and confirm
steps.text: Read the organization report and suggestions, then explicitly confirm formal tasks and objects.

steps.title: Execute and retain results
steps.text: The web interface and agent share business data; outputs, materials and actions return to the project.

steps.title: Retain attention and notification state
steps.text: Record attention, execution events and notification state so organization reports and subsequent actions can be linked to projects.

keysafe-password-manager.description: Full-stack development connecting the product interface, data management and Web3 integration for everyday password management and access protection.
keysafe-password-manager.title: KeySafe: Bringing Password Management and Protection into One Product

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Connect password management and access protection in the same product

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Full-stack development connecting the interface, data management and Web3 integration

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Password management development, demonstration link and documentation

steps.title: Define the password management direction
steps.text: Explore the combination of Web2 and Web3 through decentralized password management.

steps.title: Connect the full-stack components
steps.text: Use technologies including Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL to connect the interface and data management.

steps.title: Consider protection mechanisms
steps.text: The design includes a master password, multiple encryption strategies and two-factor protection.

steps.title: Provide a project demonstration
steps.text: Provide a demonstration and documentation covering the interface, data management and Web3 integration.

multi-cloud-management.description: Leading a unified multi-cloud resource platform and customer integration to address scattered resources, disconnected monitoring and fragmented cost reporting.
multi-cloud-management.title: Multi-Cloud Resource Management: One Operations Entry Point for Customer Environments

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Unify resource and operations access, managing state, alerts and costs together

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Platform architecture, full-stack development and customer environment integration

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Unified resource model, cross-cloud monitoring and operations automation modules

steps.title: Unify the resource model
steps.text: Design a cross-cloud resource model connecting platforms such as Volcano Engine and Alibaba Cloud.

steps.title: Build a management interface
steps.text: Use Vue and Django to build a resource platform with separate frontend and backend layers.

steps.title: Connect operations capabilities
steps.text: Unify monitoring and alerts, and develop lifecycle management, cost analysis and automated alert handling.

steps.title: Integrate customer environments
steps.text: The platform integrates more than 15 customer environments and centrally manages over 100 cloud servers.

enterprise-gitops-platform.description: Building a reviewable, traceable release process across environments to address slow releases, configuration differences and manual operations.
enterprise-gitops-platform.title: Enterprise GitOps Delivery: Deploying Across Environments from Versioned Configuration

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Shorten release cycles and improve consistency and reliability across environments

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Architecture, platform delivery, configuration standards and team adoption

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Automated releases, environment templates, review and rollback processes

steps.title: Manage configuration in Git
steps.text: Centrally manage infrastructure and application configuration while retaining change history.

steps.title: Create templates for multiple environments
steps.text: Use Kustomize to organize environment differences and define configuration templates and review standards.

steps.title: Connect automated releases
steps.text: Build a GitLab Runner and Argo CD release pipeline with consistent multi-environment processes.

steps.title: Support team adoption
steps.text: Use documentation and training to help development and operations teams continue using the release platform.

kubernetes-platform.description: Building a container runtime platform and supporting the containerization of over 50 applications to improve resource use, environment consistency and maintenance.
kubernetes-platform.title: Enterprise Container Platform and Application Migration

overview.label: Project objective
overview.value: Unify application infrastructure and improve deployment efficiency and observability

overview.label: My responsibility
overview.value: Cluster delivery, image standards, observability and application migration

overview.label: Core deliverables
overview.value: Production cluster, image pipelines, logging, monitoring and migration standards

steps.title: Build the runtime platform
steps.text: Design and deploy a production Kubernetes cluster, choosing high-availability and networking approaches.

steps.title: Standardize application images
steps.text: Build image pipelines and standardize base images and containerization.

steps.title: Connect logs and monitoring
steps.text: Build shared logging, monitoring and alerting using ELK and Prometheus.

steps.title: Advance application migration
steps.text: Define migration standards and guide developers through containerizing over 50 applications.
